authorReview.method: Full visual reading of all ten original PDF pages including shared L4–6 summary continuation and same-source crops. No website VI read or comparison.

textPolicy.viText: Visual physical line wraps joined by single space; printed words/case/accents/punctuation retained; mixed Chinese/Vietnamese inline spacing regularized without token changes.
textPolicy.fragments: Physical print lines recorded. Chinese-only examples are not translated.
textPolicy.rawPos: Printed labels retained without inference or runtime POS conversion.
textPolicy.repeatedOccurrences: Repeated headers/instructions are separate occurrences. Shared summary records scopeLessons [4,5,6], not individual L6-only targets.
